title: VantageCare compliance-led outreach slate
content:
Quick overview:
- Target: VantageCare (mid-market healthcare analytics + clinical workflow vendor). Core product = NLP-powered clinical summarization, coding assistance, and care coordination workflows for ambulatory clinics and smaller health systems.
- Why now: moving from heuristics + vendor SaaS AI proxy to in-house/partnered inference because of rising PHI concerns and cost while scaling token volume. They mentioned pilot with RAG/LLM for notes summarization in Q3 TW.

Hypothesis (how Redwood fits):
- Primary ask: a deployment that isolates PHI and provides auditability + key management (likely Private or Dedicated).
- Secondary: cost predictability for high token volumes (daily batch summarization jobs), and per-route observability so their ML infra team can tune quality regressions.
- Win strategy: lead with private deployment options + quick PoC on dedicated GPUs, benchmark latency & cost vs their current vendor, and show rollbacks/fallbacks to smaller quantized model for night-batch processing.

Key personas / stakeholders (mapping):
- VP Engineering: Claire Donovan — cares about security posture, KMS/HSM integration, deployment model, operational burden.
- Head of Clinical Informatics: Dr. Samir Patel — cares about output quality, audit trail, clinical accuracy, failure modes.
- Infra Lead / DevOps: Lina Gomez — cares about rollout automation, monitoring, and SRE playbooks.
- Procurement / Security Officer: Amir Khan — contract terms, SOC2, BAAs, data residency.

Discovery questions to validate (for intro call):
1) Volume profile: avg tokens/day, burst patterns, batch vs interactive.
2) Data residency: any regional/legal constraints (state-level, EU patients?).
3) PHI handling today: encryption at rest/in transit, redaction, logging needs.
4) Acceptance thresholds: latency targets for clinical UI vs nightly batch costs.
5) Evaluation set: do they have labeled prompts/evals we can run?

Outbound sequence (3-touch primer):
- Email 1 (Intro): 2–3 short paragraphs: reference pilot, high-level fit (private + audit logs), offer quick benchmark with existing sample set. CTA: 20–30 min tech sync.
- Email 2 (Follow-up): share short one-pager with cost/latency anchors for small pilot (2 GPUs for 2 weeks).
- Call script: 6–8 min opening, 10–12 min discovery, 8 min demo/next steps.

Cold call opener (30s):
"Hi Claire, Maya Chen at Redwood Inference — quick question: how are you currently running clinical note summarization for PHI data? We help teams move from vendor-hosted proxies to private/dedicated inference that reduces per-token cost and gives full auditability. Thought a short benchmark comparing latency and cost might be useful — could we schedule 20 minutes?"

Objection handling (cheat sheet):
- "We already have a vendor": Ask which metrics (cost, latency, compliance) fall short. Offer blind benchmark and show how fallbacks keep app online.
- "We can't host PHI": Offer Private with customer-managed VPC and KMS/HSM integrations; mention BAAs.
- "Too expensive to migrate": Anchor with Dedicated pricing example + night-batch quantized model to push cost down 3–4x.
- "Quality concerns": Propose eval harness using their prompts + Redwood Optimize recommendations plus canary rollouts.

PoC/Proof plan (minimal):
- 2-week technical benchmark: 1) run their sample workload on Redwood Dedicated (2x A10-equivalent or 1x A100) 2) measure latency p95, cost/token, and output-safety false positives 3) produce audit log export and KMS integration test.
- Success criteria: under X ms p95 for interactive UI (TBD in discovery), cost < current vendor by 20%, and audit logs + BAA sign-off.

Materials to prep before outreach:
- 1-page pilot brief (one-pager) with expected cost anchors for small/medium/large volumes (draft attached in repo).
- Sample contract bullet points covering BAA, data residency, and basic SLA language.
- Example eval set template + instructions for redaction if they prefer.

Next steps / personal to-dos (Maya):
- Draft email 1 + one-pager by 2025-11-06.
- Confirm benchmark infra availability with infra team (Ethan) by 2025-11-07.
- Reach out to Claire via LinkedIn + email on 2025-11-10.

Notes & mottos: keep messages compliance-forward but short. Avoid product laundry lists. Anchor value in lowered unit cost and auditability. If we get to technical call, focus first 10 minutes on topology & KMS, next 10 on cost/throughput, last 10 on rollouts and monitoring.
